title: Restart the Mac
summary: Use the Terminal to restart your Mac immediately. This is useful if the graphical menu is unresponsive or you prefer command-line control.

steps.explain: Run the reboot command with administrator privileges to restart the system immediately.
steps.expect: The Mac will begin the shutdown process and restart shortly.

rollback.explain: There is no command to cancel a reboot once initiated. You must wait for the system to restart.

warnings: Save all open documents before running this command, as they may not be saved automatically.
This command requires your administrator password.
